name: Emperor Ling of Later Han
bio: Emperor Ling (A.D. 156-189) ruled the Later (Eastern) Han dynasty from 168 until his death.
The archive holds one poem from Fir-Flower Tablets (1921), a short song of summer pleasure on a palace canal.

poems.title: Proclaiming the Joy of Certain Hours
poems.author: Emperor Ling of Later Han
poems.translator: trans. Florence Ayscough and Amy Lowell (1921)
poems.text:
Cool wind rising. Sun sparkling on the wide canal.
Pink lotuses, bent down by day, spread open at night.
There is too much pleasure; a day cannot contain it.
Clear sounds of strings, smooth flowing notes of flageolets--we sing the "Jade Love-Bird" song.
A thousand years? Ten thousand? Nothing could exceed such delight.
